title: 21st Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِىْ فِيْهِ اِلٰى مَرْضَاتِكَ دَلِيْلًا،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) make for me a course that takes me to Your pleasure,

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيْهِ عَلَيَّ سَبِيْلًا،
verses.translation: do not make for Satan a course to me,
and make Paradise my home and dwelling.
O He Who settles the needs of the beseechers!
